starting-off.speaker: Kolodion
starting-off.text: Hey there, how are you? Are you enjoying the bloodshed?

options.text: I think I've had enough for now.

steps.player: I think I've had enough for now.

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: A shame. You're a good battle mage. I hope to see you soon.

options.text: How can I use my new spells outside of the arena?

steps.player: How can I use my new spells outside of the arena?

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: Experience, my friend, experience. Once you've used the spell enough times in the arena, you'll be able to use them in the rest of Gielinor.

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: Not so good for the citizens; they won't stand a chance.

steps.player: How am I doing so far?

steps.text: If player has cast Saradomin Strike less than 51 times:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: You still need to train with the strike spell inside the arena before you can use it outside.
If player has cast Saradomin Strike at least 51 times:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: You have completed over half of the training needed to use the strike spell outside of the arena.
If player has cast Saradomin Strike at least 90 times:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: You are almost ready to use the strike spell outside of the arena.
If player has cast Saradomin Strike at least 100 times:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: You're experienced enough to use the strike spell anywhere.
If player has cast Claws of Guthix less than 51 times:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: You still need to train with the claw spell inside the arena before you can use it outside.
If player has cast Claws of Guthix at least 51 times:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: You have completed over half of the training needed to use the claw spell outside of the arena.
If player has cast Claws of Guthix at least 90 times:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: You are almost ready to use the claw spell outside of the arena.
If player has cast Claws of Guthix at least 100 times:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: You're experienced enough to use the claw spell anywhere.
If player has cast Flames of Zamorak less than 51 times:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: You still need to train with the flame spell inside the arena before you can use it outside.
If player has cast Flames of Zamorak at least 51 times:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: You have completed over half of the training needed to use the flame spell outside of the arena.
If player has cast Flames of Zamorak at least 90 times:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: You are almost ready to use the flame spell outside of the arena.
If player has cast Flames of Zamorak at least 100 times:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: You're experienced enough to use the flame spell anywhere.

options.text: Are there any more challenges available?

steps.player: Are there any more challenges available?

steps.text: If player hasn't mastered all the god spells yet:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: You still need to learn how to cast all god spells outside of the arena.

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: I've made a note of the spells you still need to learn in your journal.
If player doesn't have 75 Magic:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: You have indeed shown potential, [player name].

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: However, a wizard of your level wouldn't stand a chance.
If player has mastered all the god spells and is 75 Magic:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: I am one of the most powerful mages in existence. But even my power has limitations. There are some beings however that have power exceeding even my own.

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: I have detected three life forces within the Wilderness, each of them giving out a strange magical power, one unlike any I have ever felt before.

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: If we could harness the power of these beings, I could imbue your god cape with that power, greatly increasing its potential.

options.text: Great, I've been waiting for an improvement!

steps.player: Great, I've been waiting for an improvement!
What do you need me to do?

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: I will need you to kill these three beings and bring me their remains. Even in death, their power should be great enough for me to harness it for our own uses.

steps.player: Where am I supposed to find these beings?

steps.text: If the player has room in their inventory for the symbol:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: Here, take this enchanted symbol of the gods. It will guide you to the creatures.
Kolodion hands you an enchanted symbol.

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: Bring me the remains of all three magical beings. Do this and I will imbue their combined power into a single god cape of your choice.

options.text: Where can I find these beings?
Any advice on fighting the beings?
Tell me more about these beings.
Thanks, bye.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have room in their inventory for the symbol:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: You'll need to free up an inventory space before we continue.

options.text: Actually, my current cape is fine.

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: I see... If you ever change your mind, you know where to find me.

starting-off-talking-to-kolodion-again.text: If the player doesn't have an enchanted symbol:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: Here, take this enchanted symbol of the gods. It will guide you to the creatures.
Kolodion hands you an enchanted symbol.

starting-off-talking-to-kolodion-again.text: If the player doesn't have an enchanted symbol and their inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: You'll need to free up an inventory space before we continue.

starting-off-talking-to-kolodion-again.speaker: Kolodion
starting-off-talking-to-kolodion-again.text: Bring me the remains of all three magical beings. Do this and I will imbue their combined power into a single god cape of your choice.

options.text: Where can I find these beings?

steps.player: Where can I find these beings?

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: They can all be found in the Wilderness. The enchanted symbol can track their unique magical energies, leading you to their exact locations.

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: Be warned though, the symbol will take a blood sacrifice every time it's used.

options.text: Any advice on fighting the beings?

steps.player: Any advice on fighting the beings?

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: They can't be harmed by normal magic, melee or ranged attacks, you will need to use the god combat spell corresponding to the creature you are fighting.

options.text: Tell me more about these beings.

steps.player: Tell me more about these beings.

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: One is a justiciar. According to legend, the justiciars were the elite of Saradomin's forces. Some worked alone, operating as assassins behind enemy lines. Others led entire armies in Saradomin's name.

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: I couldn't tell you why this one wanders the Wilderness, but I suspect he has good reason.

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: The second is a Demon of Zamorak. From what I can tell, he is completely mad. He roams the Wilderness, killing all who he comes across without mercy. Even his own kind do not escape his fury.

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: He's known to battle the justiciar quite regularly, perhaps they are old enemies.

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: The final being is a Guthixian Ent. Like most followers of Guthix, he will avoid combat if possible. Make no mistake though, he is deadly when threatened.

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: He seems to take great interest in the other two creatures. Maybe he is trying to keep a balance between them.

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: All three of them give off a unique magical energy, one unlike any I have ever felt before. The fact that the three of them are so different, yet possess powers so similar, is very odd indeed.

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: I'd be very interested in learning more about the source of their power.

options.text: Thanks, bye.

steps.speaker: Kolodion
steps.text: Farewell, [player name].
It appears the creatures have moved locations, the symbol glows slightly as it locates their new positions.
